expected_witness_fact_sets.scope_note: Oracle expected sets preserve all outgoing Member and membership assertions; kernel facts are the required witness projection only. Full source sets were checked against raw capture; the required assertion projection was checked against both expected sets and kernel facts.

limitations: The review certifies captured evidence only; it does not claim a complete roster or transactional snapshot.
The pre/post capture comparison establishes stability of the scoped typed-result multisets, not stability of uncaptured data.
review_method: Independent read-only extraction from preserved raw typed SPARQL JSON bindings and preserved kernel execution facts; no scorer or kernel helper imports; no endpoint requests or kernel rerun.

scope.answer_scope: qualifying identities observed in captured RDF, not a certified complete roster
